label: Lyon’s spiritual baptism is not a bodiless event
text: Calling the rite spiritual does not eliminate material action: hands and a book remain part of the ceremony.
attribution: Inference from the ritual’s claim and rubric — Lyon PA 36 IV.8–18, 49–52.

sources.title: Occitan ritual, Lyon PA 36, Marvyn Roy Harris critical edition (Rialto)
